title: Mobius audit record (MASP 0.1)
description: One JSON line per action. hash = sha256(JSON array of the hashed fields in order: action_id, ts, device_id, tool, params, status, error_code, duration_ms, agent, session_id, decision, rule_id, action_class, amount, prev_hash). sig = Ed25519 over `${hash}|${agent_session ?? ''}`. The first record's prev_hash is "genesis".

params.description: JSON of redacted parameters. Never typed text, secrets or screen content.

agent.description: Session sub if a signed session was presented, else the client name

rule_id.description: builtin.*, app.declared, or a policy rule id
